items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary no-spend, reversible growth; blocked for new public launches, monetization expansion, security-sensitive exposure, and launch-readiness changes. Evidence: compliance baseline reports 37 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown across 61 sites, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings; data quality is 5 green and 2 yellow, including aggregate unattributed affiliate revenue; analytics and SEO evidence are available for configured sites; operations and fleet-doctor evidence are unavailable. Do not treat incomplete telemetry alone as a growth blocker. Exact decision: retain ordinary reversible work only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, configuration, tracking, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims. Keep SearchWoot private. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are evidenced closed. No task is closed. Woot API deal and price-history use is blocked because evidence confirms API access but not storage, derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, advertising, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights, while public terms restrict commercial/public reuse. User alerts and sync results, GA4 analytics, and operational logs/Cloudflare processing are evidence_needed. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the field-level source-rights matrix, repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent and GA4 settings capture, log/vendor/DPA inventory, and incident/deletion/correction/request procedures. Prepare but do not send a human-counsel-reviewed permission request. Keep the private gate unchanged.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; missing written redistribution/commercial permission, field-level rights, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and affiliate/advertising terms. Smallest action: complete a dated rights matrix and prepare a counsel-reviewed permission request without sending it. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor, notification-consent, and unsubscribe evidence. Smallest action: produce a read-only data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional review. Smallest action: capture current configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and request procedures. Smallest action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction, notification, vendor, and future affiliate or advertising questions.
